blockers.finding: The candidate does not meet its own declared promotion floor: floor_passed.hit63_ge_55pct=false (observed_hit_63d=0.5355 < gate 0.55). The only floor leg it clears is abs_effect63_ge_1pct at 0.010075 — 0.75 basis points above the 0.01 cutoff, a hairline pass. A 53.55% hit / +1.0% 63d-excess cell that sits below its own hit gate is exactly the marginal profile expected from a false-discovery pulled off a 110-wide search. No OOS holdout, timing placebo, or block-bootstrap CI is attached to demonstrate the effect is not a screen artifact.

The mechanism strips out the exact ingredient that the sibling OOS gauntlet identified as the source of edge. A16 uses complex_scope='any' (engine/oracle/compounds.py L398: scope=='any' returns all candidate episodes with no complex filter) — i.e. '>=3 nodes ANYWHERE have onset outflow.' The validated sibling A15 uses scope='opposite'; the R1 gauntlet (ORACLE_COMPOUND_GAUNTLET_R1.md 'Read' section) named A15's mechanism as 'rotation-driven mean reversion (local capitulation coincident with active displacement from the OPPOSITE risk pole).' A16 discards the directional rotation signal and reduces to 'buy a washout during broad market-wide de-risking' — a generic panic/beta proxy, not a rotation edge. The stated mechanism ('active cross-map liquidation pressure') describes market-wide risk-off, which is a plausible tautology: broad onset-outflow clustering is itself a proxy for a market drawdown, and buying any oversold ETF during a drawdown is mean-reversion-to-beta, not sector alpha vs SPY.

blockers.finding: A16 is a near-sibling of an already-adjudicated family. It sits in the same washout x outflow basin as A15 (validated, reversion gauntlet PASS), A9, A13 (screened n=0), A17 — all family 'A' from the same 2026-07-04 external-brainstorm batch. R1 explicitly states five compounds cleared the mechanical floor (A9, A15, A16, A17, C6) and then deliberately carried only 'the two headline candidates plus A9' into the OOS+placebo gauntlet, i.e. A16 was screened and set aside, NOT independently validated. Adopting A16 as its own registry candidate re-surfaces a member of an already-triaged cluster whose directional variant (A15) already covers the mechanism-quality case, while A16 is the weaker undifferentiated variant. Not a hard identity-duplicate of A15 (any!=opposite, 3-in-10 vs 2-in-20), so classified major not blocker.

reviewer.best_counterargument: A16 is PIT-clean, computes over a survivorship-clean 27-year 11-ETF universe, and clears the effect-size and n floors on 1,352 fires with 3/4 eras positive and the recent (2023-2026) era positive. It lives in the one basin the program has repeatedly found live (washout x active-flow-stress), and its directional sibling A15 passed a full reversion gauntlet at WR .737 with an OOS holdout — so the family mechanism is real, not imagined. 'Any-scope, 3-in-10-sessions' is a defensibly distinct, broader-net variant that could capture capitulation episodes A15's opposite-only filter misses, and it is being adopted as display-only, which is exactly the pre-registration-before-gauntlet stage where a wider net is cheap to carry.
reviewer.minimum_fix_to_reconsider: Register a dedicated BH-FDR family for this adoption batch (declare the count before p-values), then subject A16 to the same R1/P3-style gauntlet A15 received: OOS holdout (report holdout effect sign, hit>=0.52, n>=100), timing/count-matched placebo (real 63d mean > 95th pctile of random-timing draws), and block-bootstrap CI. Additionally, demonstrate A16's edge is not fully contained by A15 (an entry-set containment / marginal-fire test like the W3 22.6% containment analysis) — i.e. that 'any'-scope adds real capitulation entries beyond the opposite-scope rotation signal rather than diluting it with broad-de-risking beta. Absent a positive OOS holdout AND a placebo pass AND non-containment, the sub-55% hit rate should keep this NULL.
reviewer.falsifier_spec: In a pre-registered OOS holdout (split at 2019-12-31, matching the R1 protocol), A16 has holdout hit_63d < 0.52 OR a holdout 63d-excess mean that flips sign vs the dev period; OR, in a count-matched random-timing placebo, the real 63d mean fails to exceed the 95th percentile of the placebo distribution. Either outcome confirms the 'any-scope broad-outflow' entry is capturing market-wide beta/panic timing rather than a durable sector-reversion edge.
reviewer.human_review_question: Should A16 (the undifferentiated 'any-complex, 3-nodes-in-10-sessions' washout variant, hit_63d=0.5355 below the 0.55 floor and never carried into the R1 OOS/placebo gauntlet) be defer-killed as a weaker duplicate of the already-validated directional sibling A15 — YES to defer/kill until it passes its own registered OOS+placebo gauntlet, NO to advance it to paper alongside A15?
